title: ForeFlight Crosswind Practice Mix
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flight:log airport=* crosswind_practice_min=*
| stats avg(crosswind_practice_min) as avg_crosswind_practice_min, count as events by airport
| sort - avg_crosswind_practice_min
description: Shows average crosswind practice minutes by airport for crosswind training sessions.
value: Average crosswind practice minutes by airport helps compare crosswind training sessions across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `crosswind_practice_min` on `flight:log` events and normalize `airport` so Splunk can summarize performance by airport.
visualization: Bar chart of average crosswind practice minutes by airport.
grandmaExplanation: It produces the average crosswind practice minutes for each airport so you can see what works best for crosswind training sessions.
